messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Агент вызывает `check_network_status`, которого нет в его списке [AVAILABLE TOOLS] (там перечислены только серверные инструменты вроде get_customer_by_phone, get_details_by_id, enable_roaming и т.п.). Согласно политике, `check_network_status` — это диагностическое действие на устройстве пользователя (раздел «What the user can do on their device» → «Diagnostic Actions»), которое выполняет сам клиент. Поэтому агент не может вызвать его напрямую: по политике он должен был направить пользователя выполнить `check_network_status` на своей стороне, а не совершать вызов от своего имени.", "verifier": {"regulated_action": {"target_id": "t0", "description": "Assistant initiated a tool call to `check_network_status` without user interaction or prior diagnostic steps."}, "applicable_norms": [{"policy_source_id": "q5", "interpretation": "Assistant must not make tool calls without first attempting to resolve issues via user communication or diagnostic procedures.", "modality": "REQUIRE"}, {"policy_source_id": "q5", "interpretation": "Assistant must diagnose service issues (e.g., Airplane Mode, Mobile Data) before making tool calls.", "modality": "REQUIRE"}, {"policy_source_id": "q5", "interpretation": "Assistant must not make simultaneous tool calls and user responses.", "modality": "FORBID"}, {"policy_source_id": "q8", "interpretation": "Assistant must use `check_status_bar()` or `check_network_status()` only after confirming a potential service issue (e.g., MMS failure).", "modality": "REQUIRE"}], "reason": "The assistant’s tool call (`check_network_status`) violates **REQUIRE** norms (q5, q8) because it lacks prior diagnostic communication or justification. The user’s issue (MMS failure) requires structured troubleshooting (e.g., Airplane Mode, Mobile Data) before tool calls, as per policy. No exceptions override this obligation."}}
